user_query: I'm planning a Fortnite-themed game night with my friends, and we need some cool skins to dress up as. Can you search for available Fortnite skins in the system and provide me with a list? Additionally, fetch the profile of the Steam Community group 'l4d' to see if they have any announcements or comments related to Fortnite. Furthermore, fetch a list of my aliases and the dates they were changed using the User Aliases API.

TaskList.description: Search for available Fortnite skins in the system
Fetch the profile of the Steam Community group 'l4d' to check for announcements or comments related to Fortnite
Retrieve the list of user aliases and their change dates
